counter-psi.purpose: The 24-hour PSI on the large roller counter. Size is 0.993 x drum height. SF Pro is a stand-in the build carries, not the house display face.

counter-aqi.purpose: The WAQI AQI on the small roller counter, floored at 9pt.

engraving.purpose: Legends, scale numerals, the time and the stale mark. max(9, 9u).

bezel-inscription.purpose: Regional PSIs at N, E, S, W on the bezel ring; relief copy by day, lume by night.

accessory-headline.purpose: PSI and AQI on the rectangular and inline accessories; system .headline, Dynamic Type.

accessory-detail.purpose: Region, band and time under the headline; system .caption at a 0.8 minimum scale.

shadows.name: bezel-lip
shadows.value: stroke 6u, blur 2.4u, black 55% day / 90% night, ring offset (-0.6u, -1.1u)
shadows.purpose: Shades the dial's upper-left inner edge under the bezel.

shadows.name: needle-cast
shadows.value: radius 0.9u, offset (0.9u, 1.4u), black 38% day / 60% night / none accented
shadows.purpose: The needle standing off the dial.

shadows.name: hub-drop
shadows.purpose: The hub cap standing off the dial.

shadows.name: counter-well
shadows.value: inner stroke 1.6u blurred 1u, black 80%; glint white 14% to 3% at 46%, hard cut at 48%
shadows.purpose: The recessed slot and its split glass.

shadows.name: drum-wrap
shadows.value: black 75% to clear over the top 20%, clear to black 80% over the bottom 20%
shadows.purpose: Figures rolling over the curve of each wheel.

shadows.name: lume-glow
shadows.value: radius 1.6u text / 1.2u ticks / 2u needle, #ccedc2 at 60% (85% needle)
shadows.purpose: Night only. Never on the stale mark.

shadows.name: engraving-relief
shadows.value: copy of the letters 0.55u lower, #fff0bd at 55%, no blur

motion.name: counter-roll
motion.purpose: Each wheel rolls its own figure up or down, clipped by the drum.

motion.name: needle-sweep
motion.value: SwiftUI .animation(.smooth(duration: 1.2), value: psi) on rotation and length scale
motion.purpose: The needle swings to the new value and settles 0.3s after the wheels. Reduce Motion is not consulted.

narrative.overview:
psimeter is one instrument. On the Home Screen it is a 164 pt square on the reference iPhone 17 Pro. A gunmetal plate with four slotted screws holds a knurled brass bezel and a round dial. The dial carries a shallow five-band enamel arc with one needle, a wide three-wheel roller counter for the 24-hour PSI, a small counter for the WAQI AQI, and engraved legends. Every mark on the face is metal, enamel, glass, a tick or engraved text. There are no buttons, icons, chips or cards. On the Lock Screen, where the materials cannot survive vibrant rendering, the accessories drop to plain system type and make no attempt to imitate brass.

The world changes material with the appearance. It never inverts. Day is grained silver, black engraving and a blued-steel needle. Night is black lacquer with radium lume: legends, ticks and wheel figures glow, the needle turns gunmetal with a lume strip, and the bezel tile becomes a tone-mapped, darker copy of the day brass. A tinted or clear Home Screen gets a third finish, an open line drawing that keeps the engraved structure and puts the needle and figures in the accent group.

The reading is the product, so the figures carry it and the band supports it. Figures never take the band colour. The band shows only as the needle's position over the enamel, where the current band is the brightest segment. The face is dense, about a dozen engraved strings on 164 pt, and it holds together with two type voices, one light source and a 9 pt floor.
keyCharacteristics: One square instrument, drawn in code over three raster textures, scaled from a 170 pt authoring unit.
Exact figures on roller wheels; the band arc is supporting cast.
A material switch for night (lacquer, lume, dimmed brass), never an inverted palette.
Engraved serif for every legend and heavy tabular figures for the two readings. Nothing else is set on the face.
Light from the upper left everywhere: dial sheen, crystal glare, needle and hub shadows, counter frames.
Honest states drawn in the material: blank wheels for missing data, a rust or ember stale mark, a pegged needle.

rules.name: The One Lit Band Rule
rules.body: The segment holding the current PSI draws at full enamel under a 38% white glaze. The other four are muted (22% toward mid-grey by day, 15% toward black by night) under a 22% glaze. With no PSI reading, no segment is lit.

rules.name: The Figures Never Take the Band Rule
rules.body: Wheel figures stay Wheel White by day and Radium Lume by night at every value. The band shows only as the needle over the enamel.

rules.name: The Lume Is Night Rule
rules.body: Only the night finish glows. The day finish has no glow anywhere, and the stale mark never glows in any finish. Stale is painted, not luminous.

rules.name: The Engraver's Floor Rule
rules.body: Engraved text never drops below 9 pt. When space runs out, drop scale numerals first (the 50 already went), then shorten the legend. Never shrink. The floor sits two points under the iOS 11 pt guidance and holds only for tertiary engraving on the fixed-art face. App UI stays at 11 pt or above.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The face has two type voices. The engraved serif sets every legend, numeral, time and inscription; the wheel figures set the two readings. A third voice, or the serif on a wheel, breaks the instrument.

rules.name: The 170 Grid Rule
rules.body: Author every measure in u = side / 170 and let the view scale. Only type has a floor.

rules.name: The Raster Opening Rule
rules.body: The dial is a circle of radius 0.389 of the side at (0.498, 0.480). That matches the black opening in the `BezelTile` artwork, so the code dial covers it exactly. Move the dial and the plate's black shows.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Light comes from the upper left. Highlights sit up and left (dial sheen, crystal glare and crescent, hub cap gradient); shadows fall down and right (needle, hub, counters). A new part lit from anywhere else is wrong.

rules.name: The Glass Over Everything Rule
rules.body: The crystal is the top layer, and the needle, hub and counters sit under its glare. The accented finish has no crystal.

dos: Do measure everything in u = side / 170 and keep the dial at (0.498, 0.480) with radius 0.389 of the side.
Do keep the exact figures on the wheels and let the arc only place the band.
Do switch materials for night: lacquer face, lume ink with glow, `BezelTileNight`, a gunmetal needle with a lume strip, the counter frame dimmed 22%, the current enamel warmed 22% toward Lamp Warmth.
Do label each reading with its scale and source in the engraving (`PSI · 24H · CENTRAL`, `AQI · WAQI`).
Do show missing data as blank wheels and a named failure in the legend, with the needle parked at 0 when PSI is missing.
Do peg the needle at 400 and let the counter show the true figure, up to 999.
Do light every new part from the upper left and cast its shadow down and right.
Do put the needle and the wheel figures in the accent group, and drop the raster plate and the crystal in the accented finish.
donts: Don't colour the figures, the counters or the plate by band. The thesis refuses the band-coloured number tile; the band lives in the enamel arc only.
Don't draw AQI on the arc or give it a needle. The arc is NEA's PSI scale; AQI has its own counter.
Don't shrink engraved text below 9 pt. Drop numerals or shorten the legend instead.
Don't let anything glow by day, and don't let the stale mark glow at all.
Don't invent a figure to fill a wheel. A blank wheel is the honest state.
Don't treat the wheels' SF Pro Bold as the house display face. It is a stand-in the build carries.
Don't put icons, chips, cards or buttons on the face. Every mark is engraving, enamel, metal or glass.
